item.text: I’ll read the selected lyric, then reconstruct the Urdu body verse by verse from the existing Roman text.

item.aggregated_output:
---
title: "مت بھول یہ مفتی کلمہ کی پہچان حسینؑ ماتم ہے"
language: "Urdu"
lang: "ur"
direction: "ltr"
kalamType: "Noha"
tags: ["noUrdu"]
aliases: []
published: false
---

Mat bhool ye mufti kalmey ki, Pehchan Hussain ka matam hay
Is kufr ke aalam me har ki, Azaan Hussain ka matam hay

1
1. Tu zindagi bhar shukraney ke, Kar sajdey ghar insan hai tu
Har ek insan pe mahshar tak, Ehsan hussein ka matam hay

2
2. Tu khud kuch deen me laya hai, Tuney kalmey ko sharmaya hay
Kalmey ki qasam is kalmey par, Qurban hussein ka matam hay

3
3. Terey fatwo se mitjayega, Ye matam bhool hai bhool teri
Jo ghairat mand hain un sab ka, Imaan hussein ka matam hay

4
4. Ham matam kartey sino par, tera chehra surkh kyun hota hay
Maloom huwa haq batil ka, Meezaan Hussein ka matam hay

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
s=Path('src/data/lyrics/mt-bhol-ye-mfti-klmh-ki-phchan-husain-matam-hai.md').read_text()
_, meta, body=s.split('---',2)
roman=meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n',1)[1]
for section, digits in [(roman,'1234'),(body,'۱۲۳۴')]:
    blocks=[[line.strip() for line in block.splitlines()] for block in section.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
    assert len(blocks)==5 and len(blocks[0])==2
    assert all(len(block)==3 and block[0]==digit for block,digit in zip(blocks[1:],digits))
assert 'direction: \"rtl\"' in meta and 'noUrdu' not in meta
print('Verified two opening verses and four two-verse stanzas in both scripts.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu body and moved the Roman transcription into `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions contain two opening verses and four two-verse stanzas. Set the direction to `rtl` and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read `ghar` as گر (“if”) in the first stanza and kept `har ki` as ہر کی in the opening.
